Subject: Light Up a Life 2026

Our Light Up a Life tree will be in the shop window again this year.

Memory tags will be available in the shop from Monday 16 November, with a suggested donation of £3. There will be envelopes on the counter if you would rather take a tag home and write it there. You are welcome to write it in the shop too.

We will switch the lights on at 4pm on Saturday 28 November. The children from Gildencroft Primary are coming back to sing a few carols, and Doreen is making her mince pies again. If last year is anything to go by, I would advise not leaving it too long before you have one.

All the names on the tags will be read out at the hospice remembrance service on Sunday 13 December at 3pm, in the day centre. You don’t have to come to the service for your loved one’s name to be read.

It is seven years this month since my husband Ray died at the hospice. The first year I hung his tag on the tree, I could hardly write it. Now I write it at the counter in the shop, with the same pen. I still take a moment over it.

The tree is for anyone who is grieving, whether or not your family has a connection with the hospice. You are welcome to come in and stand by it for a while. There is no need to buy anything.

Thank you to everyone who remembered someone with us last year. So many names were on the tree, and it meant a great deal to see them there. We would be glad to welcome you back, and to welcome anyone joining us for the first time.

Jean
